svg.title: An inspectable record separates judgment from checks
svg.desc: A conceptual diagram separates human interpretation from automated checks. An assessor bounds the process, selects sources, states evidence propositions and interprets findings. The complete record retains Counsel, Judgment, Command, Correction, Repair and Reform, plus institutional-record and assessment-packet integrity. Software checks declared structure, references, derivation and bound file identity. It does not establish source truth or validate the assessor's interpretation.
